method: PCM16 signed integer extrema count both -32768 and +32767. Historical inspect_audio samples_at_full_scale uses normalized abs>=1 and counts only the negative endpoint for PCM16. This addendum corrects that measurement limitation without rewriting historical baseline measurements.
